8 أَغَارُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَٱكْتَسَحُوهُمْ (tropical:) They made a hostile attack, or incursion, upon them, and took all their property. (S, K. *) ―
-b2- إِكْتَسَحْنَا مَالَ بَنِى فُلَانٍ (tropical:) We took [or swept off] all the property of the sous of such a one, leaving them nothing. (L.) ―
-b3- [In like manner you say] كَسَحَ مِنَ المَالِ مَا شَآءَ [(tropical:) He swept off what he pleased of the property]; as also كَثَحَ. (K, voce كَثَحَ.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
